panel.appearance: Theme and accent color for the app.
panel.playback: How videos play and how much motion you see.
panel.history: Titles you've watched on this device.
panel.backend: The streaming backend this app connects to.
panel.tmdb: Content language and region for TMDB.

appearance.theme_desc: Match your system, or force light or dark.
appearance.accent_desc: The highlight color used across the app.

playback.autoplay_desc: Automatically play the next episode after a 5s countdown
playback.auto_skip_intro_desc: Skip intro segments automatically when timing data is available
playback.reduce_motion_desc: Minimize animations and transitions across the app

history.title: Watch History
history.clear_confirm_desc: This removes every title from your history. This can't be undone.

reset.title: Reset all data
reset.desc: Clears your watch history, settings, and preferences on this device.
reset.confirm_desc: This clears your history, theme, language, and every preference on this device. This can't be undone.

backend.title: Backend
backend.url_desc: Custom backend URL. Leave empty to use the default.

tmdb.title: TMDB
tmdb.language_desc: Interface language and the language of TMDB titles, posters and overviews.
